definitions.explanation: Something that brings happiness or enjoyment; a source of pleasure.
The feeling of eager expectation for something pleasant to come.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}が{楽|たの}しみです。
examples.english: I'm looking forward to the trip.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}の{楽|たの}しみは{映画|えいが}を{見|み}ることです。
examples.english: My weekend pleasure is watching movies.

examples.japanese: お{会|あ}いできるのを{楽|たの}しみにしています。
examples.english: I'm looking forward to meeting you.

notes:
{楽|たの}しみ is the noun form of {楽|たの}しい (enjoyable).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜が{楽|たの}しみです: I'm looking forward to ~
- 〜を{楽|たの}しみにする: to look forward to ~
- 〜を{楽|たの}しみにしている: to be looking forward to ~

RELATED WORDS:
- {楽|たの}しい: fun, enjoyable (adjective)
- {楽|たの}しむ: to enjoy (verb)
- {楽|たの}しみ{方|かた}: way of enjoying

Note: When expressing anticipation, {楽|たの}しみ functions as a na-adjective: {楽|たの}しみな{予定|よてい} (plans I'm looking forward to)
